thread:
sylvia: heads up — canary for release v2.4.1 was skipped by deploy-bot in us-west-2. saw a digest mismatch during the mirror check, suspect ecr replication lag :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy halted: immutable-tag-check failed for image redwood-internal-ecr/redwood/service:release-2026-03-20. expected digest sha256:0a1b2c3d..., found sha256:9f8e7d6c... in target region.

michael: interesting — was that tag retagged after CI promoted it? or did cross-account replication stall?

sylvia: CI shows the tag was created at 2026-03-20T14:02Z, registry replication finished in us-east-1 but aws-replication metrics show a ~7 min lag to us-west-2. canary window 14:10Z, so it hit the check during the lag.

deepa: can we safely pin the canary to the digest instead of tag to avoid future skews? we do that for prod but not for canaries.

jules: we should avoid workflow that retags mutable tags after promotion. but for this incident, what's the mitigation to get the canary back online?

sylvia: options: 1) wait for replication to finish (estimate ~5–10m), then re-run deploybot canary job; 2) manually retag the target region with the correct digest (ops-only, requires coordination + audit); 3) roll forward by forcing image digest pin in the canary manifest and kick deploy.

ops-oncall: I'm oncall — can do manual pin in us-west-2 if we want immediate canary. prefer to wait if low-risk, but product wants smoke in 30m.

michael: product said smoke test is helpful but not blocking. i'd wait 10m and retry automatically, unless replication still shows lag.

deepa: agree. also we should update the release notes doc to include pinning guidance and change window note (replication lag risk). cc @jules for a follow-up PR to the CI promotion step.

sylvia: re-run scheduled for 14:21Z. i'll monitor replication metrics and post back. if it still fails, ops-oncall please do manual pin and record the manual retag in release notes.

deploy-bot: retry scheduled by sylvia at 1954321060. will re-run immutable-tag-check.

sylvia: update — replication catch-up completed at 14:19Z, re-run succeeded, canary progressing. leaving this thread open for release notes action items.

jules: filing follow-up: add digest-pin option to canary job and a short blurb in the release runbook about "replication lag during heavy pushes". owning PR: @jules.

ops-oncall: noted, no manual intervention needed. closing loop after PR merges. :thumbsup:
